queuePublication.operation: Swap each sg_worker_bin between producer and immutable queue slot; no memcpy of triangle records.

asyncPublication.operation: Both packed/raw async publication likewise swap bins; packing vertices is separate.

cacheReplay.operation: Filtered replay copies selected16B records; unfiltered replay memcpy copies each full nonempty bin.

lifetimeConstraint.operation: Coverage retirement may compact entry tris/offsets and write a hidden-bit tail. Epoch/key invalidation and replacement can reuse entry storage. Borrowing needs entry lifetime/immutability control and filtered traversal or scatter compaction. Existing job storage is independently owned.
